title: Trailhead Catalog Search
success_evidence: A crafted search changes the synthetic catalog query's boolean logic and returns products unrelated to the literal search text.
root_cause: The lesson variant concatenates untrusted search text into a SQLite statement.
mitigation: Use parameterized queries and keep query structure separate from user-provided values.

juice_shop_reference.lesson: Transfer SQL-injection reasoning to an unfamiliar catalog implementation.
